title: Promotion to Shieldbearer
description: Requirements for promotion to the rank of Shieldbearer.
body:
To advance from Companion to Shieldbearer, you must first earn 8 Scrolls of Heroic Deeds.

Once the required deeds have been earned, a Warden will announce your advancement and issue you your Shieldbearer mission in the Great Hall.

Long ago, a Shieldbearer of the Argent Gryphon ventured into the Maze of Lost Souls, never to return. You are charged with following in their footsteps and searching the depths of the maze for any trace of the missing Gryphon.

Should you find the Shieldbearer's remains, recover their Griffin Shield and return with it to the Argent Gryphon.

Upon completion, return to the Great Hall and present a screenshot of yourself with the recovered Griffin Shield as proof of your deed. You may then be promoted to Shieldbearer.

title: Promotion to Vanguard
description: Requirements for promotion to the rank of Vanguard.
body:
To advance from Shieldbearer to Vanguard, you must first earn 8 Scrolls of Heroic Deeds while having served as Shieldbearer.

Once the required deeds have been earned, a Warden will announce your advancement and issue you your Vanguard mission. Your mission must be declared in the Great Hall before you may begin.

Complete one of the following:
- Together with at least one other Gryphon, defeat a boss that presents a reasonable challenge for your character's level.
or...
- Fully unlock the bestiary entries of three creatures appropriate to your character's level. This challenge may be undertaken alone.

Upon completion, return to the Great Hall and present a screenshot as proof of your deeds. You may then be promoted to Vanguard.

title: Promotion to Chevalier
description: Requirements for promotion to the rank of Chevalier.
body:
To advance from Vanguard to Chevalier, you must first earn 12 Scrolls of Heroic Deeds while serving as a Vanguard.

Once the required deeds have been earned, a Warden will announce your advancement and issue you your Chevalier mission.

Every Chevalier must earn an outfit worthy of a warrior of the Argent Gryphon. Before setting out, announce your chosen outfit in the Great Hall.

Complete one of the following:
- Choose an outfit whose quest presents a reasonable challenge for your character's level, and complete the necessary deeds to obtain it.
or...
- If you already have an outfit in mind that perfectly embodies how you imagine a Chevalier of the Argent Gryphon should look, you may choose that instead, regardless of the difficulty involved in obtaining it. Upon acquiring the outfit, write a short roleplaying story convincing your fellow Gryphons why this raiment is truly worthy of a Chevalier.

Upon completion, return to the Great Hall and present a screenshot of yourself wearing your chosen outfit as proof of your deed. You may then be promoted to Chevalier.

title: Promotion to Silverheart
description: Requirements for promotion to the rank of Silverheart.
body:
To advance from Chevalier to Silverheart, you must first earn 16 Scrolls of Heroic Deeds while serving as a Chevalier.

Once the required deeds have been earned, a Warden will announce your advancement and issue you your Silverheart mission.

Your final charge is to earn the Gryphon mount.

Before setting out, announce your challenge in the Great Hall. You must then complete the necessary deeds to earn the Gryphon's trust and claim it as your mount.

Upon completion, return to the Great Hall and present a screenshot of yourself riding your Gryphon as proof of your deed. You may then be promoted to Silverheart.
